title: Make superseded-basis transport quarantine diagnosable and explicitly recoverable
outcome: An operator can diagnose a runtime transport quarantine captured before a transport change or re-enrollment, and has a documented safe recovery path without bypassing cleanup or newer quarantine fences.
acceptance: Expose or document the quarantined enrollment/transport basis and distinguish it from the current basis without exposing credentials.

Specify and independently review the recovery contract for a superseded-basis quarantine; exact prior cleanup and newer-quarantine identity fences remain mandatory, with admission and reservations unchanged.
Regression coverage and required exact-input gate/review accompany any behavior change.
